S08 E10 — Pups and Katie Stop the Barking Kitty Crew; Pups Save the Glasses
Mayor Humdinger disrupts Adventure Bay with his barking kitties; Katie and the pups rescue the town; Cap'n Turbot loses his glasses.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S10 E17 — Mighty Pups Stop the Mighty Queen; Mighty Pups Stop the Hiccups
The Mighty Pups must stop Sweetie from using her new powers to take over Adventure Bay; Mighty Nano gets the hiccups, so it's up to Liberty and the Mighty Pups to find a cure.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S11 E03 — Pups Plus a Plucky Chicken; Pups Save a Pet Show
When Humdinger steals Farmer Al's super-powered seeds, Chickaletta joins the PAW Patrol to help stop the mayor's corny plan; when Humdinger steals Katie and Cali's tiaras, it's up to the pups to save their costumes and the pet show.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S08 E09 — Pups Save the Treasure Cruise; Pups Save Rocket Ryder
Mayor Humdinger tricks people into sailing icy waters in search of an Antarctic treasure, but they all need to be rescued when they get stranded on shore; the pups need to rescue Ryder and Alex when they get out of control on a rocket-powered ATV.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S10 E02 — Pups Save a High Flying Hen; Pups Save a Sloth
After Chickaletta accidentally takes flight on a toy airplane, it's up to the team to rescue her; Mayor Humdinger mistakes a sloth for a monkey, racing to find it and cover up his blunder.

title: Rubble & Crew
description:
S04 E04 — The Crew Builds a Pirate Ship Café; The Crew Builds a Sierra Sparkle Experience
When Café Carl's pirate-themed restaurant gets caught in rough waters, the pups set sail with a new construction solution; Sierra Sparkle calls in help from Rubble & Crew to build a special experience for all her fans in Builder Cove.

title: Rubble & Crew
description:
S04 E06 — The Crew Installs a New Observatory Lens; The Crew Builds a Meow Yard
Rubble moves with his family of construction pups to the nearby town of Builder Cove where they live, play, and build whatever the community needs.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S08 E02 — Pups Save a Sweet Mayor; Pups Save a Magic Trick
Encased in a huge chocolate bunny, Humdinger is carried away by hungry raccoons; when a magic trick goes awry, the Adventure Bay Easter Festival is overrun by wild bunnies.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S11 E16 — Pups Save the Chicken Conductor; Pups Save the Digi Tal Stylists
Chickaletta is left driving the train after an enormous chicken floaty launches Engineer Ed out the window; when Katie needs to close the Pet Parlor early, Digi and Tal volunteer to keep the shop open.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S04 E26 — Sea Patrol: Pups Save Puplantis
Sid Swashbuckle the Pirate and his first pup mate, Arrby, steal the giant pearl-making shell that gives Puplantis its magic.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S04 E13 — Sea Patrol: Pups Save a Baby Octopus
The Sea Patrol must save the day when a baby octopus gets separated from its mother and sinks the Flounder.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S11 E04 — Pups Save Helga and the Humsquatch; Pups Save the Missing Bone-Stone
While Humdinger gets dressed for a day with his Hummy Mummy, the Humsquatch accidentally puts on the mayor's suit and takes his place; when a precious bone goes missing, the Pups' only chance at getting it back is to team up with Sweetie.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S12 E07 — Search and Rescue: Pups Help the Chickens Cross the Road; Search and Rescue: Pups Save a Lost Ryder
Chickaletta's family is scattered around town, causing traffic jams; the Safety and Rescue Pups have to help the chickens cross the road; Chase leads a mission to rescue a lost Ryder which involves clues, tools and Chewington.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S05 E03 — A Royal Mess
Dirty Deema steals Molly and Gil's soap and makes the Kingdom of Clean very dirty; Molly and Gil have to get their soap back and clean up the kingdom.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S05 E26 — Taste Buddies!
When Chefs Molly and Gil bring their tasty food truck to Bland Land, they discover that Baron von Bland only lets his subjects eat Bland Bread; the Chefs must find a way to bring taste to the kingdom.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S01 E04 — Build Me a Building!
The Bubble Guppies learn about construction while building a doghouse for Bubble Puppy.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:

In the Gourmet Galaxy, everyone loves yummy food, but when Gen. Yuck turns everything icky, only a recipe for delicious moon muffins can stop her; master chef Goby and his apprentice, Deema, must bake those muffins and save the galaxy.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S01 E14 — Boy Meets Squirrel
The Bubble Guppies learn about trees.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:

title: Bubble Guppies
description:

title: Bubble Guppies
description:

title: Bubble Guppies
description:

Goby must retrace his steps to find his lost toy at a construction site.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S05 E21 — A Load of Litterbugs!
On the U.S.S. Recycler, Captain Deema and her crew strive to leave every planet cleaner than they found it; however, their mission is put to the test when a crew of messy Litterbugs, led by the evil Garbage Khan, take over their ship.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S05 E04 — The Good, the Sad, and the Grumpy!
When Mr. Grumpfish turns up in Happy Junction, he makes everyone in town really grumpy; Sheriff Molly must find a way to help everyone handle their tricky emotions.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S05 E08 — A Furry Tale!
Hansel and Gretel have to get Bubble Puppy and Bubble Kitty home safe to the Furry Godmother, but they're being stalked by a witch.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S06 E14 — The Big Rig Bandit!
When reckless hyena Spotty steals young elephant Eli from the savanna, Wildlife Rangers Zooli and Goby hop into their big rig to rescue him; when the big rig chase lands Spotty and Eli in danger, it's up to the Guppies to save the day.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S01 E09 — We Totally Rock!
The Bubble Guppies take the stage and learn about rock music.

title: Peppa Pig
description:
Around the World; Castle; Grandpa Pig's Train to the Rescue
Miss Rabbit lends Peppa and her family a plane for the day, and they get swept off on an adventure around the world; the family visits a castle; when Miss Rabbit's train breaks down, Grandpa Pig lends her his little train, Gertrude.

title: Peppa Pig
description:
Roller Disco; Weather Station; Talking; Grandpa's Rock Garden; Winter Games

title: Peppa Pig
description:

description:

The PAW Patrol team and Mayor Goodway travel to Dino Island for a tour led by Rex; during the visit, the group discovers that Timmy the Tyrannosaurus rex fears Mayor Goodway's pet chicken, Chickaletta.

title: PAW Patrol
description:

Tracker and Lucita Buena call on the Air Rescue Pups to help save an irreplaceable Mother Tree; it's then up to the Paw Patrol to fix Mr. Porter's ice cream freezer before everything melts!

title: Rubble & Crew
description:

When Speed Meister rains on the Builder Cove Sing-Off, Rubble and Crew saves the show by building a giant dome over the stadium; Rubble and crew build an elaborate baggage claim system at the airport when nobody can find their bags after flying home.

title: PAW Patrol
description:

The pups go to Barkingburg to investigate when the Princess thinks she has seen a ghost; while on safari with Carlos and Tracker, Mayor Humdinger steals a magic mask.

title: Deer Squad
description:

Vanessa Pressley is on Dino Island to film her new dino documentary; she and the cameraman get carried off by a Brachiosaurus; when Daring Danny X's dino-stunt goes awry, he winds up with a grouchy Spinosaurus on his trail!

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S05 E19 — Pups and the Werepuppy!; Pups Save a Sleepwalking Mayor
When Rocky goes missing at Uncle Otis' cabin in the woods, the PAW Patrol needs to solve the mystery of the Werepuppy; on Cowboy Day at the Wingnuts Dude Ranch, Mayor Goodway braves the hazards of the ranch while sleepwalking.

title: The Marsupilamis
description:
Dance Off; The Show Must Go On
Jade, a poor player but a talented dancer, faces Mr. Max in a duel; Mica has stage fright for the school play, but the Marsus save the show.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S09 E02 — Pups Meet the Cat Pack
When Mayor Humdinger transforms his robot cat Meow-Meow into a tiger-sized metal-eating menace, the PAW Patrol calls in the Cat Pack for help with stopping the creature.

title: Rubble & Crew
description:
S05 E05 — The Crew Builds A Cooking Store; The Crew Builds A Food Truck Zipline
When the pups need to make the new cooking store look special, Mix gets an idea to build with giant pasta noodles; Rubble and Grandpa Gravel build a giant zip line to help them win an awesome food truck race against Speed Meister and Mr. McTurtle!

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S05 E14 — Ultimate Rescue: Pups Save the Tigers
When searching for elusive rumble top tigers, the Turbots fall into a cave deep inside a volcano; the PAW Patrol performs a paratrooper-style rescue from Skye's ultimate copter.

title: Peppa Pig
description:
Parachute Jump; Miss Rabbit's Taxi; Playing Pretend; Scooters; George's Racing Car
The school roof is leaking, so Mummy Pig does a parachute jump to raise money to fix it; Miss Rabbit spends the day picking people up and dropping people off in her job as taxi driver.

title: Peppa Pig
description:
Nursery Rhymes; Digger World; The Doll Hospital; Wendy Wolf's Birthday; Princess Peppa
Madame Gazelle and the playgroup share their best nursery rhymes; Mummy and Daddy Pig take Peppa and George to Digger World, where they build walls and knock them over again.

title: Peppa Pig
description:
Move to Music; School Project; Simple Science; Pedro Is Late; Gerald Giraffe
Madame Gazelle gets Peppa and her playgroup friends to dance to all different styles of music; for their school project, Peppa and her friends build castles and bring them into playgroup.

title: Peppa Pig
description:
Mr. Bull Is Getting Married; Getting Ready for a Wedding; The Wedding Day; Party Bus; Families
Mr. Bull and Mrs. Cow are getting married; everyone gets ready for the wedding; the day of Mrs. Cow and Mr. Bull's wedding arrives; Peppa gets an invitation to Candy Cat's birthday party; the children draw family pictures.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S12 E04 — Pups Save Hummy Mummy's New Home; Pups Save Adventure Bakes
A pair of alligators take Mayor Humdinger's mother, Helga Humdinger, on a wild ride across Foggy Bottom!; Winnie Winnington is determined to beat Mayor Goodway and Chickaletta in a cooking competition to find Adventure Bay's best bakers.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S05 E21 — Pups Save a Cuckoo Clock; Pups Save Ms. Marjorie's House
Jake's family cuckoo clock slides down the mountainside with Chickaletta stuck inside; mysterious holes appear all over Ms. Marjorie's yard.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S03 E13 — Pups Save Old Trusty; Pups Save a Pony
Ryder investigates when jets of water start springing up all over town; the PAW Patrol helps a rancher find a spooked horse.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S03 E08 — Pups Save Daring Danny X; Pups in a Fix
Ryder performs an incredible stunt during a rescue, inspiring a young boy to become a daredevil; Ryder entrusts the care of Adventure Bay to Robo-Dog while he and the pups take a vacation.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S06 E06 — Pups and the Stinky Bubble Trouble; Pups Save the Baby Ostriches
A strange odor chases jungle animals away from their homes; after Olivia the Ostrich falls into a canyon, the pups work together to lift her to safety and protect her soon-to-hatch eggs.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S04 E09 — Pups Save a Sleepwalking Bear; Pups Save Dude Ranch Danny
The pups need to get a sleepwalking bear back home before he wakes up; Daring Danny X takes his horse off the trail and ends up on a wild ride.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S05 E04 — Pups Save a High Flying Skye; Pups Go for the Gold
When Corny runs away from Farmer Al's farm during a blackout, the pups need to light the way to get them home safely; uncle Otis hurls down Jake's Mountain in a runaway mine car.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S11 E06 — Air Rescue: Pups Save the Airport Opening
Adventure Bay is getting a new airport! Sweetie tries to take the Princess' place at the grand opening.

title: Rubble & Crew
description:
S04 E03 — The Crew Builds a Fancy Drive-Thru Restaurant; The Crew Builds a Castle Show
When Camila the truck driver needs a place to stop and eat, the pups and Café Carl have a fancy idea; Park Ranger Rose and Rosie the goat are putting on a show; when Rosie disappears, can the pups find her before showtime?

title: Rubble & Crew
description:
S03 E03 — The Crew Builds a Hotel Elevator; The Crew Builds a Popcorn-Cat Cafe
Rubble and crew help at Hotel Hadley after snow and when stairs fail, its bow wow build time; when they cause popcorn chaos, Rubble and crew make the café cat-friendly.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S08 E01 — Pups Save a Runaway Rooster; Pups Save a Snowbound Cow
Chickaletta and Roosterio run away from a chicken show and get stuck on top of a runaway drone. When Bettina wanders up Jake's mountain and gets caught in a snowstorm, it's up to the PAW Patrol to bring her safely down.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S10 E09 — Pups Stop a Gold Finding Machine; Pups Help Mayor Humdinger Out of a Jam
The PAW Patrol springs into action when a digging machine goes out-of-control and takes Uncle Otis on a wild ride; Digi and Tal try to help Mayor Humdinger but leave the Mayor covered in jam, so the Pups must rescue him from hungry animals.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S03 E09 — Pups Save a Dragon; Pups Save the Three Little Pigs
Marshall wakes from a nap to find a real, fire-breathing dragon guarding a sleeping Katie in the Lookout Tower; the pups build a house for three little piglets.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S03 E05 — Air Pups
The Pups must come to the rescue when a family of monkeys scatters into the jungle after being scared off by lava erupting from a volcano.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S10 E24 — Pups Save a Runaway Robo-Chicken Purse; Pups Save the Buggy Trekkers
Digi and Tal's inventions to help a busy Mayor Goodway go haywire and lead to a wild woodland chase; when Mayor Humdinger squeezes himself into the Trekkers' friendly dune buggy race, his cheating ways put the other racers in jeopardy.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S08 E08 — Pups Save the Dizzy Dust Express; Pups Save the Treetop Trekkers
When the Dizzy Dust Express appears with no one aboard, the PAW Patrol must stop the runaway train and find the missing passengers; Ms. Marjorie, Tilly Turbot and Mayor Goodway get stranded in the treetops on their jungle zip-lining adventure.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S06 E18 — Puppy Girl and Super Pup!
When supervillain Felina Meow starts turning all the dogs at the annual dog show into cats, it's up to superheroes Puppy Girl and Super Pup to stop her.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S04 E06 — Temple of the Lost Puppy!
When Bubble Puppy disappears after biting an ancient magic bone, the Guppies must embark on an adventure to find him.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S06 E11 — The Kingdom of Sleepwell!
All is not well in the normally well-rested Kingdom of Sleepwell because Princess Deema can't fall asleep; her royal court comes to her aid, but even magic doesn't work.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S05 E01 — The New Guppy!
The Sea Witch steals the Guppies' magical jewels so she can rule the Seven Seas; the Guppies must get their jewels back and stop her before it's too late.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S01 E08 — Who's Gonna Play the Big Bad Wolf?
When an actor cannot perform at a play, Deema must take the stage.
